title: Day 1: The Lockdown
body: The bells didn't stop ringing. They just kept going until the power cut out. We followed the protocol: doors locked, lights off, kids under the desks. From the window, I saw the parents arriving to pick up their children. But they didn't wait at the gates. They tore the gates off the hinges. They weren't calling names; they were just sniffing the air. I told the class it’s just a very long drill.
